texts: Day 112. The $(item)Horizon Diver$() takes me through an event horizon. Rule one: $(thing)carry a Geodesic Anchor$(). Without one, tidal forces kill within two seconds - in the black hole and the white hole alike.

Why the tides kill: near a black hole, gravity changes so steeply over the length of a body that the feet are pulled far harder than the head. The stretching is called $(thing)spaghettification$(), and it is not a figure of speech.

Even anchored, it is hostile down here. Time is dilated: I move, swing and dig slower. Gravity is 2.5 times as strong. Below y=16 the singularity tears everything apart. $(thing)Tidal Horrors$() hunt in the dark, and their touch $(thing)spaghettifies$().

Log, second descent. An $(item)Einstein-Rosen Bridge$() stands at 0, 121, 0. I stepped through and came out inside the $(thing)white hole$() - a black hole run backwards, which nothing can enter, only leave. Low gravity, blinding light, everything pushed outward. The $(thing)Photon Moths$() here are harmless.

Neither side is enough alone. From the black hole: $(item)Tidal Alloy$() and $(item)Frozen Photons$(). From the white hole: $(item)Retrocausal Crystals$() and $(item)Primordial Ejecta$(). Together they make the $(item)Einstein-Rosen Core$() - and with it, new bridges I can build myself.
Entry undated, on purpose. Sends objects back along a closed timelike curve so they exist twice. The universe is not amused.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.

A $(thing)closed timelike curve$() is a path through spacetime that returns to its own past. General relativity allows them in a few exotic solutions; nobody has ever found one in nature.$(br2)This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

How it works: feed an item together with a $(item)Closed Timelike Curve$() and both come back - plus a second copy of the item. It works on Tesseract Cores, singularities, white hole fragments, superintelligences, stellar cores, wormhole throats and even pocket universes. I try not to think about the last one.
Weaves worldlines. Reverses the arrow of time, ties temporal knots and enforces self-consistency on time loops.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Note to self: a $(thing)worldline$() is the path an object traces through spacetime - every moment of its existence strung together like thread. The loom handles them exactly that way. What it weaves is in my notes on temporal mechanics.
Taps the energy of empty space that drives the expansion of the universe.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.

Since 1998 we have known the expansion of the universe is speeding up. Whatever drives it - $(thing)dark energy$(), perhaps the energy of the vacuum itself - makes up roughly 70% of everything there is. The siphon drinks from it.$(br2)This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

Day 58. The $(item)Tensor Calculus Engine$() works up from $(item)Lorentz Transforms$() and the $(item)Minkowski Lattice$() to the $(item)Metric$() and $(item)Riemann Curvature Tensors$() and finally the $(item)Einstein Field Core$().

The order follows the physics. First flat $(thing)Minkowski$() spacetime, where the $(thing)Lorentz transform$() says how lengths and times change between moving observers. Then gravity: the $(thing)metric$() measures distance in curved spacetime, the $(thing)Riemann tensor$() measures the curvature, and Einstein's equations tie that curvature to matter.

Why it matters: wormhole throats need an $(item)Einstein Field Core$(), and Alcubierre coils need $(item)metric tensors$(). Kugelblitz chambers can merge black holes into $(item)Gravitational Wave Crystals$() - the ripple of two horizons becoming one, frozen solid.

temporal_mechanics.title: Knots in Time
texts: Day 140. The $(item)Chrono Loom$() reverses the $(item)Arrow of Time$(), ties $(item)Temporal Knots$() (a Möbius strip helps - a surface with only one side seemed fitting) and crystallises the $(item)Novikov$() self-consistency principle.

Novikov's principle, plainly: if time travel is possible, the only histories allowed are ones that are already consistent. You cannot stop your own birth; something always intervenes.$(br2)Here it is enforced. Closed timelike curves now need a Novikov Crystal: a time loop is only allowed if it can never produce a paradox.
Computes in curved spacetime: Lorentz transformations, metrics, curvature and finally Einstein's field equations.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Note to self: a $(thing)tensor$() is an object whose components change in a precise way when you change coordinates, so the physics it describes does not. That is the whole trick of general relativity - write the laws in tensors, and every observer agrees on them.

Holds a bubble of false vacuum open in the Quantum Foam and catches the virtual particles that flicker through it. What it catches depends on where it stands and how it is tuned.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.

Quantum field theory says empty space is never quite empty: $(thing)virtual particles$() borrow energy for an instant and vanish again. In the Foam they flicker densely enough to catch.$(br2)This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

Field notes. It only works in the $(thing)Quantum Foam$(). Each virtual particle has a $(thing)resonance$() (0-100) that changes from place to place. The harvester catches whichever particle its dial is tuned closest to, and the closer the better.

So I take a $(item)Resonance Probe$() to where the harvester stands and read the four values. Then I either move the harvester or retune it, to choose what it makes. Two wasted afternoons before I accepted that the readings are local.
Opens a traversable wormhole to distant stars and drags their matter through.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.

In the textbooks, an Einstein-Rosen bridge pinches shut faster than light could cross it; holding one open would take negative energy at the throat. This one stays open.$(br2)This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

Day 205. Inside the ring I can see the other end of the bridge - another sky. Each transit drags back matter from a distant star system or a neighbouring brane. I have started keeping a list of which.
